svg.title: Systems that are not allowed to stop: from khokhloma to semiconductors to software and PolarGrid
svg.desc: Three gold lines, each forking from the one above. Khokhloma, in Russian old faith communities. Semiconductors, in Soviet industrialization. Software, PolarGrid and commercial global distributed compute, in Canada and AI progress. The older lines run on. The bright line ends in the question: Who does it work for?
svg.text: SYSTEMS THAT ARE NOT ALLOWED TO STOP
